n. a spicy dish that originated in northern Africa; consists of pasta steamed with a meat and vegetable stew
n. a pasta made in northern Africa of crushed and steamed semolina

coushatta.translation: [医]考沙塔人; [地名] [美国] 考沙塔

[法] 同辈表亲或堂亲

cousin-german.definition: n the child of your aunt or uncle
cousin-german.translation: n. 堂兄弟, 表姐妹, 堂姐妹, 表兄弟

cousin-in-law.translation: n. 姻堂兄妹,姻表兄妹

cousinhood.definition:
n. The state or condition of a cousin; also, the
   collective body of cousins; kinsfolk.

cousinry.definition:

   persons who stand in the relation of cousins to a given person or

cousins.definition: n the child of your aunt or uncle

coussinet.definition:
n. A stone placed on the impost of a pier for receiving the
   first stone of an arch.
n. That part of the Ionic capital between the abacus and
   quarter round, which forms the volute.
